island.name: Island Assistive
setting.island_assistive.enabled.descrip: Off by default. Watch for nearby listed mobs. New discoveries sound every 5 seconds until acknowledged in chat.
setting.island_assistive.radius.descript: 3D distance, 256 blocks by default. Only mobs sent to your client by the server can be detected.
setting.island_assistive.volume.descript: Game master and UI sound volume settings still apply.
Build a baseline for 2 seconds and report existing targets together without a repeating alarm.
island.chat.initial: [Island Assistive] Initial scan found %s listed mobs:
island.sound.subtitle: Island Assistive: mob alert
island.watchlist.title: Mob watchlist
island.watchlist.help: Select a rule to edit, or enter a target and click Add. Click the name matching mode to change it.
island.watchlist.load_failed: Watchlist could not load; using zombie villagers. Saving will back up the original file.
island.watchlist.name: Custom name
island.watchlist.draft: Draft updated. Save the watchlist to apply your changes.
island.watchlist.invalid_type: Use a full type ID such as minecraft:zombie_villager.
island.watchlist.unknown_type: Unknown entity type. Check the ID.
island.watchlist.missing_target: Enter an entity type, or choose a name match and enter a name.
island.watchlist.save_failed: Could not save the watchlist. Your draft is preserved; please retry.
Move locally on supported ground only when needed.
setting.island_assistive.miningRadius.de: Maximum distance in blocks from the starting position.
setting.island_assistive.miningTurnSpeed: Maximum degrees per second; slows near the aim point.
setting.island_assistive.miningCooldown: Wait for attack cooldown before starting
Wait once when starting or resuming; new blocks and automatic tool changes do not restart the wait.
island.mining.select_help: Right-click the target. Esc cancels; times out in 30 seconds. Selection does not use the block.
island.mining.toggle_help: Delete toggles mining by default. Manual movement, turning, attack, hotbar keys or scrolling stops it; GUI input does not. Configure inventory, screens, item use and focus suspension separately.
island.mining.selecting: Right-click the one-block target; Esc cancels
island.mining.load_failed: Target could not load; select again
island.mining.wrong_world: Paused: world / dimension changed or player died
island.mining.standing_required: Stand on solid ground, out of water, vehicles and flight
island.mining.displaced: Paused: moved outside the activity area or changed height
island.mining.interrupted: Paused: menu, item use or window lost focus
island.mining.no_safe_position: Paused: no safe reachable position nearby
island.mining.movement_blocked: Paused: movement blocked or timed out
setting.island_assistive.miningPauseInve: Pause while inventory or containers are open
Enabled by default. Release mining controls while inventory or containers are open; resume automatically when closed. Independent of other screens.
setting.island_assistive.miningPauseScre: Off by default. Chat, settings and other non-container screens suspend mining until closed.
setting.island_assistive.miningPauseUsin: Off by default. Suspend during eating, drawing a bow or other ongoing item use; resume afterwards. When disabled, mining stays active and waits where vanilla prevents simultaneous breaking.
setting.island_assistive.miningPauseUnfo: Pause when the window loses focus
Off by default. Suspend when switching windows and resume when returning. Applies only to this mining session.
island.mining.suspended_inventory: Inventory or container open; resumes when closed
island.mining.suspended_world: Singleplayer world paused; continues when the world resumes
island.mining.waiting_item: Mining active; waiting for vanilla item use to finish
